race.comment: LATHLAIN (3) is down in grade and getting within a length of Befuddle, who won at Sandown on Wed, as she did two back now looks pretty good form. Drawn to enjoy a nice run just off the lead. Expected to be in the finish. MELEYS (8) returns from a break. Placed in latest jump-out at Pakenham. Opened last campaign with a third at Geelong over 1235m. Consistent runner and a must-include. GALANT KNIGHT (1) kicked off this campaign with a win two runs ago. Couldn't follow that up last time out when ninth over 1600m at Pakenham. Best figures measure up and can atone here. SILVER BULLET (2) has yet to hit his straps in two runs this time in work, the latest effort a ninth over 1400m at Bendigo. Fitter and a theat.
